# Bundled Discord RPC source

Upstream: https://github.com/azahar-emu/discord-rpc

Base commit: `cb50201fc09290cd078c7ab27917504491f7f96a`

Local changes add `name` and `status_display_type` to the presence payload. The MIT license is retained in LICENSE. This dependency is vendored to keep the frontend and the patched serializer in sync in a fresh clone.
